name: OD Profile with Convex Arc
description: OD profile with a CW arc that bulges outward toward stock. Tests arc zone construction, offset of arcs, variable roughing depth across arc region, and face from centerline.

profile_boundary.description: The finish shape (radius, Z). Arc bulges outward.

arc_segment.note: Arc center is at X=-0.366 (negative radius = centerline side). Arc bulges to peak X=0.634 radius at Z=-1.000.

roughing_boundary.description: Profile offset outward by fin_allowance_radius (0.002). Arc offset = same center, R+0.002.

arc_segment.note: Offset arc: same center, radius increased by 0.001 (wait - should be 0.002 for 0.004 dia / 2 = 0.002 radius offset)

stock_boundary.description: Rectangle from centerline to stock radius, Z_start to Z_end

closure_segments.description: OD mode: profile_end to centerline at Z_end, up centerline to Z=0

true_face_zone.description: Rectangle from X_start(0) to Stock_radius(0.750), Z=0 to Z_start(0.100)

key_test_points.note: At Z=-1.000, the arc peak is at radius 0.634. Stock is at 0.750. Only 0.116 inches of material to rough at this Z level. Tests thin material handling near arc peak.

notes: The DXF shows fin_allowance offset of 0.001 radius (from 0.002 dia). The JSON parameters specify 0.004 dia = 0.002 radius. The DXF was built with 0.002 dia allowance. Use DXF values (0.001 radius offset) as ground truth for this fixture.
Arc center at negative X (centerline side) causes outward bulge — this is the correct geometry for a convex bump on an OD part.
The roughing passes near Z=-1.000 will have very short Z travel because the arc peak is close to stock OD.
